expected_title: Reliability Model Supporting Satellite Life Extension and Disposal Operations Initiation
abstract: The final goal is to be able to dispose the satellite at end of life in a safer and more reliable manner even in case of failures. This will in turn allow to limit the proliferation of space debris in already crowded Low Earth Orbits and to be fully compliant to international Space Debris Mitigation standards and specific applicable regulations (e.g. French Law : LOS “ Lois des Opérations Spatiales ” ).
